questions.question: India won the Men's T20 Cricket World Cup in 2026. Which country did they beat in the final?
questions.funFact: With this win, India became the first team ever to win the Men's T20 World Cup three times.

questions.question: India's Chandrayaan-3 made history in 2023 by landing near which part of the Moon?
questions.funFact: India became the very first country to land a spacecraft safely near the Moon's south pole.

questions.question: India is now the country with the largest population in the world.
questions.funFact: In 2023 India passed China to become the world's most populous country, with over 1.4 billion people.

questions.question: Which Indian city got a brand-new Parliament building that opened in 2023?
questions.funFact: The new Parliament building is shaped like a triangle and can seat many more members than the old one.

questions.question: India's space agency, which launched the Chandrayaan Moon missions, is called ___.
questions.funFact: ISRO stands for the Indian Space Research Organisation and its main centre is in Bengaluru.

questions.question: Which team won the Indian Premier League (IPL) cricket title in 2026?
questions.funFact: Royal Challengers Bengaluru won the IPL in both 2025 and 2026, after waiting many years for their first title.

questions.question: In 2025, India won the ICC Champions Trophy cricket tournament.
questions.funFact: India won the 2025 Champions Trophy without losing a single match in the whole tournament.

questions.question: ISRO's upcoming Gaganyaan mission is special because it will send Indians into ___ for the first time.
questions.funFact: Gaganyaan will be India's first mission to send its own astronauts into space on an Indian rocket.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT an Indian space mission?
questions.funFact: Apollo was the American programme that first landed people on the Moon; the others are all Indian missions.

questions.question: India hosted the leaders of the world's biggest economies at the ___ summit in New Delhi in 2023.
questions.funFact: The G20 is a group of 20 major economies, and India led it for a whole year in 2023.

questions.question: Chandrayaan-3 made India the first country to land near the Moon's south pole.
questions.funFact: The spot where Chandrayaan-3's lander touched down was named 'Shiv Shakti Point'.

questions.question: The famous javelin thrower from Panipat in Haryana who is an Olympic star for India is ___.
questions.funFact: Neeraj Chopra won India's first Olympic gold medal in athletics at the Tokyo Olympics.
